title:
This epic is used to update/initialize a field on a target type with a new value.
Payload should receive:
```
targetType: is the name of the target c3 type.
field: is name of the field which needs to be updated/initialized on target type.
newValue: is the value with which the field on targetType needs to be updated with.
entityId: is the id of targetType object.
refreshDataSourceIds(optional): is an optional field contatining the dataSourceIds of UI components, which need to be refreshed.
```

For example, paylod to update/initialize `actualSensor` with a value of 'S002' on {@link ParsedSensor} with id 'PS001' would be:
```
payload: {
 targetType: "ParsedSensor",
 entityId: "PS001",
 field: "actualSensor",
 newValueForField: "S002"
}
```
name: UiSdlEpicUpdateFieldOnEntity
